pre_animation: v.sx = q.property('zoocraft:tip_x') - q.position(0);
v.sy = q.property('zoocraft:tip_y') - q.position(1) - 0.125;
v.sz = q.property('zoocraft:tip_z') - q.position(2);
v.cd = q.distance_from_camera;
v.cp = q.rotation_to_camera(0);
v.cyaw = q.rotation_to_camera(1);
v.cx = -v.cd * math.cos(v.cp) * math.sin(v.cyaw);
v.cy = -v.cd * math.sin(v.cp) - 0.125;
v.cz = v.cd * math.cos(v.cp) * math.cos(v.cyaw);
v.lp = q.camera_rotation(0);
v.ly = q.camera_rotation(1);
v.ox = -math.sin(v.ly) * math.cos(v.lp) * 0.8 - math.cos(v.ly) * 0.35;
v.oy = -math.sin(v.lp) * 0.8 - 0.25;
v.oz = math.cos(v.ly) * math.cos(v.lp) * 0.8 - math.sin(v.ly) * 0.35;
v.e = math.sqrt(math.pow(v.cx + v.ox - v.sx, 2) + math.pow(v.cy + v.oy - v.sy, 2) + math.pow(v.cz + v.oz - v.sz, 2));
v.k = math.clamp(v.cd / 4, 1, 1.5);
v.dx = v.sx + (v.cx + v.ox * v.k - v.sx) * v.w;
v.dy = v.sy + (v.cy + v.oy * v.k - v.sy) * v.w;
v.dz = v.sz + (v.cz + v.oz * v.k - v.sz) * v.w;
v.h = math.sqrt(v.dx * v.dx + v.dz * v.dz);
